The spigot.js browser client as an HTML dependency

Source: R/deps.R
spigot_dependency.Rd

spigot_app() attaches this to every page, so pages normally need nothing else. Use it directly only for a page that spigot_app() does not serve.

Usage

spigot_dependency(prefix = "/api")

Arguments

prefix

The API prefix, as given to spigot_app(). The script tag carries it as data-prefix, which is where spigot.js reads it from.

Value

An htmltools::htmlDependency().

Details

The script defines window.spigot: spigot.get(), spigot.post() and the other request functions call the API with the tab's session and resolve with the parsed reply or reject with a spigot.SpigotError; spigot.on() listens for events pushed with spigot_emit(). See vignette("client", package = "spigot").

Examples

spigot_dependency()
#> List of 10
#>  $ name      : chr "spigot"
#>  $ version   : chr "0.2.0"
#>  $ src       :List of 1
#>   ..$ file: chr "js"
#>  $ meta      : NULL
#>  $ script    :List of 2
#>   ..$ src        : chr "spigot.js"
#>   ..$ data-prefix: chr "/api"
#>  $ stylesheet: NULL
#>  $ head      : NULL
#>  $ attachment: NULL
#>  $ package   : chr "spigot"
#>  $ all_files : logi FALSE
#>  - attr(*, "class")= chr "html_dependency"
